{{Quote|The ancient laboratory around me crumbled<br />The ground shook and the buildings tumbled.<br />Quickly I rescued plants and seeds<br />Unique specimens for my research needs.<br />Later I returned for an investigation<br />And found the grounds and plants filled with radiant contamination.|A passage by Baji included in ''The Essential Guide to Alien Species''|<ref name="TEGAS" />}}
At some point by the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], an '''ecological disaster''' affected the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Barenth]]. In the vicinity of an [[ancient laboratory]], the disaster took the form of a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] that damaged the facility. The healer [[Baji]] was present at the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] during the event and subsequently resolved to reside at the facility for the rest of his life in order to try and heal the [[Plant/Legends|plants]] therein.

==Prelude==
At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] healer [[Baji]] visited an [[ancient laboratory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Barenth]] with the goal of researching healing remedies.<ref name="TEGAS" />

==The disaster==
{{Quote|In the following passage, a Ho'Din named Baji ''[&hellip;]'' describes his unique cultural reaction to an ecological disaster on a world called Barenth&mdash;a place he had visited to research healing remedies.|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species''|<ref name="TEGAS" />}}
At that point, an ecological disaster struck Barenth in the area of the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]]. A [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] collapsed several buildings of the facility while Baji rapidly collected unique specimens of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and their [[Seed/Legends|seeds]] he needed for his research and then left the laboratory.<ref name="TEGAS" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I mourned my plant brothers and knew what was right:<br />I would stay here and heal this place for the rest of my life.|A passage by Baji included in ''The Essential Guide to Alien Species''|<ref name="TEGAS" />}}
Upon his return to investigate the laboratory, Baji discovered that the facility grounds and plants located there had been tainted by a radiant contamination. Due to his sympathy for the damaged plants&mdash;and the [[Species/Legends|species]]-wide veneration the Ho'Din exhibited for plants&mdash;Baji resolved to inhabit the Barenth laboratory for the rest of his life in order to attempt to heal the plants therein. Baji later described the Barenth disaster in a rhyming passage that was eventually noted in the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', which was itself based on the notes of [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="TEGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ecological disaster on Barenth was mentioned in the [[2001]] reference book [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]].<ref name="TEGAS" />
